title: Write and Read a Text File
question: Write a line to a text file, then read and print it.
code:
file_name = "myide_sample.txt"
with open(file_name, "w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    file.write("Hello from MyIDE!\n")
with open(file_name, "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    print(file.read(), end="")
explanation: The with statement closes the file automatically after writing or reading.
